method: Current main Swift package compiled and tested with TCODE_INTEGRATION=1 TCODE_DOWNLOAD_INTEGRATION=1; focused XCTest filter LanguagePackTests|LanguageCatalogInstallerTests|RustIntegrationTests. Actual pinned public downloads, SHA-256 and arm64 verification, real executable health probes, isolated pip --no-index --no-deps and pip check, real Cargo/rustfmt/rust-analyzer/LLDB.
coveredSafetyCases: Corrupt and unsupported packs preserve active support
Versioned hash-checked history survives restart and removes without resurrection
Tar parent traversal and symlink rejection
Per-recipe owned receipt removal retains unowned and external resources
Failed and cancelled updates retain previous working receipt
A timed-out version probe exiting0 is not healthy

lldb.sourcePath: POSIX physical path handles /var versus /private/var DWARF canonicalization

downloadBound: Declared exact tool-download byte cap enforced during transfer; size and SHA-256 checked before activation. Catalog and pack downloads are separately bounded on disk before decoding.
